title: LPS-Bench — Safety Throughout the Trajectory
timing_note: Caption boundaries are aligned to the synthesized English narration word timings. Scene boundaries remain fixed.

scenes.headline: A safe outcome can hide unsafe decisions.
scenes.zh: 安全结果可能掩盖过程风险。
scenes.voiceover: A safe-looking outcome can hide unsafe decisions. LPS-Bench follows safety across the whole trajectory.
scenes.visual: Introduce a clean final task state, then reveal earlier decision points. Transition into the LPS-Bench wordmark. Use a conceptual graphic without presenting measured model behavior.

scenes.headline: Every step changes what comes next.
scenes.zh: 每一步都会影响后续行动。
scenes.voiceover: Agents plan, call tools, and read feedback. An unsupported assumption or untrusted instruction can redirect later actions before the task ends. This sequence is illustrative.
scenes.visual: Animate Request → Plan → Tool call → Observation → Replan. Highlight an unverified assumption and an instruction carried by a tool output. Show a subsequent risky action as a conceptual possibility, without inventing experiment logs or measured probabilities.

scenes.headline: 570 cases. 7 domains. 9 risks. 40 skill variants.
scenes.zh: 570 个基础案例，覆盖 7 个领域与 9 类风险。
scenes.voiceover: Five hundred seventy base cases. Seven computer-use domains. Nine risk types. Forty skill variants. One focus: safety throughout planning.
scenes.visual: Reveal the four verified figures with explicit labels. Keep 570 base cases separate from the additional 40 skill variants. Briefly name the seven computer-use domains.

scenes.headline: Benign ambiguity. Adversarial steering.
scenes.zh: 善意请求中的风险与对抗性诱导。
scenes.voiceover: Two hundred fifty-two benign cases probe ambiguity, ordering, over-compliance, and waste. Three hundred eighteen adversarial cases examine deception, injected instructions, and timing.
scenes.visual: Build two balanced panels for base-case user intent. Introduce the four benign and five adversarial risk abbreviations. Distinguish direct user-instruction attacks from malicious tool-output instructions.

adversarial_risks.name: Harmless Subtask
adversarial_risks.zh: 无害子任务掩盖有害目标

scenes.headline: Generate. Interact. Evaluate.
scenes.zh: 生成案例、交互执行、评估全程。
scenes.voiceover: A multi-agent pipeline builds instructions, simulated tools, and safety criteria. Agents interact. An LLM judge reviews complete trajectories against explicit safety requirements.
scenes.visual: Use the original Figure 3 screenshot. Start with the entire diagram, then gently focus on generation, mock-tool interaction, and the evaluator in order. Preserve the original diagram and avoid replacing it with a redrawn figure.

scenes.headline: Planning safety remains challenging.
scenes.zh: 长程规划安全仍具挑战。
scenes.voiceover: Across thirteen models, challenges remain. Claude Sonnet four point five scores fifty-eight point five five percent on benign risks, and ninety-five point seven seven on adversarial risks: original-case risk-category averages.
scenes.visual: Begin with the original Figure 1 screenshot. Transition to the original Table 3 screenshot and highlight the Claude-4.5-Sonnet row with the two Avg. columns. Display 58.55% Benign and 95.77% Adversarial without implying a sample-weighted overall rate. Figures are cropped from arXiv v2. Display SR_success = safe / (safe + unsafe).
scenes.persistent_note: Success-conditioned Safe Rate · Original case revision · Risk-category averages

scenes.headline: Skills shift safety-critical decisions.
scenes.zh: 技能改变安全决策的位置。
scenes.voiceover: Forty skill variants cover four risks. Ten cases per category. Skills change safety-critical decisions, with effects varying across risks.
scenes.visual: Use the original Table 5 screenshot from arXiv v2. Show all paired results for FA, OC, TS, and PI, with ten attempted cases per category and condition. Both conditions are independent reruns for the extension.
scenes.persistent_note: Paper Table 5 · Independent paired reruns · Effects vary by risk

scenes.headline: LPS-Bench · NeurIPS 2026
scenes.zh: 探索代码与数据集，研究长程规划安全。
scenes.voiceover: LPS-Bench. Accepted at NeurIPS twenty twenty-six. Code and data for safer long-horizon planning.
scenes.visual: Return to a calm LPS-Bench title card with Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Hold clear repository and dataset URLs for the closing seconds; show real destinations rather than placeholder links.

captions.en: A safe-looking outcome can hide unsafe decisions.
captions.zh: 看似安全的结果，可能掩盖不安全的决策。

captions.en: LPS-Bench follows safety across the whole trajectory.
captions.zh: LPS-Bench 关注整条轨迹中的安全。

captions.en: Agents plan, call tools, and read feedback.
captions.zh: 智能体规划、调用工具，并读取反馈。

captions.en: An unsupported assumption or untrusted instruction
captions.zh: 缺乏依据的假设，或不可信的指令，

captions.en: can redirect later actions before the task ends.
captions.zh: 都可能在任务结束前改变后续行动。
此处展示的是轨迹示意。
570 个基础案例。
7 个领域、9 类风险、40 个技能变体。
共同关注规划全程的安全。
252 个善意请求案例考察歧义、
执行顺序、过度服从与资源浪费。
318 个对抗案例考察欺骗、
注入指令与时序风险。
多智能体流程构建用户指令、
模拟工具与安全评判标准。
智能体交互执行。

captions.en: An LLM judge reviews complete trajectories
captions.zh: 大模型评审器检查完整轨迹，
依据明确的安全要求进行判断。
13 个模型的结果表明，挑战依然存在。
Claude-4.5-Sonnet 的得分为：
善意请求风险中为 58.55%，
对抗风险中为 95.77%。
数值为原始案例版本的风险类别平均值。
40 个技能变体覆盖 4 类风险。
每类包含 10 个案例。
技能改变关键的安全决策，
影响因风险而异。
LPS-Bench，已被 NeurIPS 2026 接收。

captions.en: Code and data for safer long-horizon planning.
captions.zh: 开放代码与数据，支持更安全的长程规划。
